READY-TO-APPLY FIX #1 (human must author) — .github/workflows/research-agent.yml: add `allowed_bots: "github-actions[bot]"` under `with:` on all THREE `anthropics/claude-code-action@v1` steps (standard Opus 4.8, deep Fable 5, deep Opus 4.8 fallback), alongside claude_code_oauth_token. Confirmed against the action's own action.yml: the input is `allowed_bots` (comma-separated bot logins, or '*'; default '' = no bots). Scope to our own bot rather than '*' — this workflow only triggers on schedule + workflow_dispatch (no comment/mention triggers), and workflow_dispatch requires write access, so no fork/external bot can reach it; '*' remains a safe fallback if the login-vs-'github-actions' match is ever in doubt.

READY-TO-APPLY FIX #2 (human must author, lower priority) — .github/workflows/visual-qa-agent.yml: raise `--max-turns 40` (the vision pass needs more than 40 turns to screenshot 3 widths, LOOK, and write the log). Arguably improve-agent's tuning domain rather than mechanic breakage; note it, don't block on it.
